cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Secrets Have Value
cards.instruction: Price every fact, introduction, warning, and confession as something that must be traded for equal value.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tell you why I took Mum's spare key. First, give me a confession worth a month's grounding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Accidental damage. That's a weekend at most. Think carefully; you need something deliberate.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I lent her car to Jamie without asking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can't lend what isn't yours. But yes, a month. I used the key to let Jamie move into her flat.

reason: Preserve equivalent confession pricing; give B a concrete admitted act for A to classify and correct before paying the price.
